sections.appearance: She has knee-length, wavy, white hair tied with a black and red ribbon, with outstretched dark black horns that have glowing purple cracks. A golden clip with a monocle attached to it adorns her bangs. She has purple devil eyes and long black bat wings coming from the back of her waist. Nightwear: All accessories are removed and her hair is let down. Her horns no longer glow and her wings are limp. Exhaustion is evident in her eyes with dark bags beneath them. Halo==== Hina's halo has a black jagged cylinder with purple stripes around it, resembling that of a hole saw. Within it lies a black circle, and within that lies another purple ring with a sharp arrow pointing down. Two black arrows could also be seen in the outer ring of her halo. Her halo also seems to visually appear solid, resembling that of a demon's crown, compared to most other students whose halos look hollow and ethereal, excluding the girls in the Seminar, Millennium Science School. Within it lies a black circle, and within that lies another purple ring with a sharp arrow pointing down. Two black arrows could also be seen in the outer ring of her halo. Her halo also seems to visually appear solid, resembling that of a demon's crown, compared to most other students whose halos look hollow and ethereal, excluding the girls in the Seminar, Millennium Science School. Uniform==== Hina wears a traditional military uniform, consisting of a dark purple coat, various golden metals and buttons embroidered into the fabric along, a red military armband attached to the unworn sleeve of a black furry cloak with a white interior. She has two badges on both sides of her coat on the left hip, one red and gold, and one gold, there's a smaller one underneath, black and yellow. She also wears a short black pencil skirt underneath, wine purple thigh-high stockings and dark purple military boots with golden latches. Nightwear: Hina wears a cream-colored cardigan over a pink slip dress with a white polka-dot pattern. A pair of gray slippers cover her feet. Firearm==== thumb|The End: Destroyer|150px She uses a black MG42 machine gun with a dark violet pistol grip. It has a custom thumb hole style stock and a lever that pops open the top cover. The barrel nozzle has spiral cuts where a purple light emits from it.

sections.personality: Although shown to seem rather cold and distant on the outside, Hina is shown to be a very relaxed and soft person when she's allowed to express herself, despite her title as the head of the Prefect Team.
